function.arguments: {"language":"js","code":"var blobs=new Map(), inventory=[]; var hash=x=>crypto.createHash('sha256').update(x).digest('hex'); for(var h of histories){var b=await fs.readFile(root+h.export_path);var lines=b.toString().split('\\n').filter(Boolean);var off=0;for(var [i,line] of lines.entries()){var r=JSON.parse(line);var visit=(v,p)=>{if(typeof v==='string'&&v.length>200){var k=hash(v);if(!blobs.has(k))blobs.set(k,{text:v,refs:[]});blobs.get(k).refs.push({file:h.export_path,row:i+1,id:r.id??r.uuid??null,field:p});}else if(v&&typeof v==='object'){for(var [k,vv]of Object.entries(v))visit(vv,p+'.'+k);}};visit(r,'$');}inventory.push({path:h.export_path,bytes:b.length,sha256:hash(b),records:lines.length});}console.log({files:inventory.length,records:inventory.reduce((s,x)=>s+x.records,0),rawBytes:inventory.reduce((s,x)=>s+x.bytes,0),uniqueLargeStrings:blobs.size,uniqueBytes:[...blobs.values()].reduce((s,x)=>s+Buffer.byteLength(x.text),0)}); console.log('research',manifest.research,'context',manifest.context,'new',manifest.initial_drift_ledger,manifest.decision_receipts);","title":"Measuring exact duplicate evidence"}
